Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call: Deployment mode qualification + pricing follow-up

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the discussion this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of what I heard:
- Goal: embed clinical note summarization into the clinician portal with sub-1s median latency for short notes (~150 tokens) and end-to-end audit logs.
- Pilot target: Q2 (May) at ~5M tokens/month; expected production scale 20–30M tokens/month in 2027.
- Data classification: PHI — legal prefers Private (VPC or on-prem) for the pilot.
- Procurement asks: predictable monthly spend and clear commit vs. month-to-month implications.
- Security asks: SOC 2 report + KMS integration walkthrough.

Deployment modes we covered (please confirm constraint):
1) Hosted API — fastest to get started, per-token pricing, Redwood-managed infra, SOC 2 compliant. Not ideal for PHI if VPC isolation required.
2) Dedicated (reserved capacity) — dedicated GPU pool in our cloud tenancy, predictable throughput, monthly reserved commit, KMS + audit logs. Good middle ground for VPC-like isolation without on-prem ops.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem) — full customer-controlled network; one-time platform license and annual support. Best for strict PHI requirements.

Attached: initial estimate (acme_estimate_v2.xlsx) with Hosted per-token vs Dedicated reserved commit (4x A100-equivalent baseline). Highlights: hosted per-token = $0.0009/token; Dedicated baseline estimate noted.

Proposed next steps:
- Lisa/procurement: confirm preferred deployment constraint for pilot (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) by Tue 3/23.
- If Dedicated/Private: I will loop in Marissa for commercial terms and Neha for the SOC 2 + KMS evidence pack.
- We will revise estimate and provide a clear 12-month reserved commit comparison if procurement requests.

Thanks —
Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
--
Attachment: acme_estimate_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks Aditya — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Legal/procurement are leaning toward Private (VPC or on-prem) for the pilot due to PHI, but they may accept Dedicated if we can get contractual guarantees around network isolation and audit logs.
2) Procurement asked for a clear monthly commitment vs month-to-month breakage cost and whether a 12-month reserved commit is meaningfully cheaper than hosted once we reach 20–30M tokens/month.
3) Security wants SOC 2 report and a KMS integration walkthrough.

I'll confirm internally and aim to reply with a preferred deployment by Tue 3/23. For now please include a 12-month reserved commit option and a Private on-prem TCO (license + support) in the updated estimate.

- Hosted (per-token): $0.0009 per input token (model: crimson-1x-curated). Estimated monthly cost: 5M tokens = $4,500; 30M tokens = $27,000.
- Dedicated (12-month reserved commit): baseline reserved fee = $15,000/month (approx. 4x A100-equivalent). Overage billed at discounted per-token rate (~$0.0005/token). We can include priority support and audit log retention SLAs under the commit.
- Private (VPC/on-prem) TCO: one-time platform license & deployment support = $120,000; annual support & maintenance = $18,000/yr. On-prem appliance/hardware is additional — we can coordinate sizing with partners.

I also attached our dedicated commit terms (redwood_dedicated_commit_terms.pdf) and a short checklist for SOC 2 + KMS artifacts.

Would it help if I prepare a two-page cost comparison (Host vs Dedicated vs Private) with three scenarios (pilot 5M/mo, scale 20M/mo, peak 30M/mo) showing monthly cash flow and capex/opex split? Happy to do that and share by Monday.
